outputs.explanation: Spatial plots show heatmap-style overlays of deconvolution scores on tissue sections; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Box plots show quartiles/median and additionally overlay individual data points (dots) for each sample, satisfying the requirement.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Bar graph shows log2 fold-change values for each gene without any individual data points overlaid to convey variability/spread of the underlying differential expression data.
Panel consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot showing averaged data, so the check does not apply.
